title: Curcumin mediates autophagy and apoptosis in granulosa cells: a study of integrated network pharmacology and molecular docking to elucidate toxicological mechanisms.
authors: Lin, Zhen; Liu, Huazhong; Yang, Chunyan; Zheng, Haiying; Zhang, Yu; Su, Weiming; Shang, Jianghua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素对颗粒细胞的毒性机制，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心是细胞凋亡/自噬而非蛋白质-DNA互作，分子对接仅用于药物-蛋白结合，与本课题TF-DNA互作无关。
abstract: Curcumin (Cur) is a flavonoid derived from Curcuma longa L. that has been shown to have a variety of biological activities, but some previous studies have described its non-negligible negative effects on female reproduction and embryo development. To further explore the toxic stress effect, this study investigated apoptosis and autophagy of healthy buffalo (Bubalus bubalis) derived granulosa cells (GCs) exposed to Cur and/or autophagy inhibitors. Results showed that Cur declined viability of GCs in a concentration-dependent manner. Apoptosis was observed in Cur-treated GCs from 3 h. Meanwhile, under Cur stress, autophagosomes accumulated in cells, and the expression levels of autophagy key proteins LC3 and Beclin 1 were up-regulated, suggesting that Cur could induce autophagy in GCs. Early autophagy inhibitor 3-methyladenine (3-MA) increased the apoptosis rate of Cur exposed GCs, but the autophagosome degradation inhibitor chloroquine (CQ) had no effect on the apoptosis rate. The network pharmacological and molecular docking analysis indicated that the perturbation of IKK/NF-kappaB might be the cause of Cur toxicity toward GCs. This study unveiled another side of Cur pharmacological effects that programmed cell death can be induced by Cur in GCs, suggesting that it should be prudent to use Cur as a clinical drug for its side effects on the female reproductive system.
abstract_zh: 姜黄素（Cur）是一种源自姜黄（Curcuma longa L.）的黄酮类化合物，已被证明具有多种生物活性，但一些先前的研究描述了其对雌性生殖和胚胎发育不可忽视的负面影响。为进一步探讨其毒性应激效应，本研究调查了暴露于Cur和/或自噬抑制剂下的健康水牛（Bubalus bubalis）来源颗粒细胞（GCs）的凋亡和自噬情况。结果显示，Cur以浓度依赖性方式降低GCs的活力。从3小时起，在Cur处理的GCs中观察到凋亡。同时，在Cur应激下，细胞中自噬体积累，自噬关键蛋白LC3和Beclin 1的表达水平上调，表明Cur可诱导GCs中的自噬。早期自噬抑制剂3-甲基腺嘌呤（3-MA）增加了Cur暴露GCs的凋亡率，但自噬体降解抑制剂氯喹（CQ）对凋亡率无影响。网络药理学和分子对接分析表明，IKK/NF-kappaB通路的扰动可能是Cur对GCs毒性的原因。本研究揭示了Cur药理作用的另一面，即Cur可诱导GCs中的程序性细胞死亡，提示在临床使用Cur时应谨慎考虑其对雌性生殖系统的副作用。
